headline: GTA 3 - the series goes 3D
title: GTA 3 2001 | How Liberty City Changed Gaming | Classic Games
video_script: GTA three changed open world games. Grand Theft Auto three was developed by DMA Design, now known as Rockstar North, and published by Rockstar Games. It arrived on PlayStation two in October two thousand one, and it was the first game in the series to move into a fully three D world. Which GTA three memory do you love most? Comment below!
description: Grand Theft Auto III arrived on PlayStation 2 in October 2001, developed by DMA Design, now Rockstar North, and published by Rockstar Games.
